displayName: OCI-MOB-005: Mobile — Intent Spoofing and Deep Link Abuse
description:
Detects Android intent spoofing or iOS deep link abuse for unauthorized actions

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: mobile — intent spoofing and deep link abuse

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_mob_005", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mobile%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%intent%') AND "value" > 0
